messages:
Lina (procurement): Quick heads-up — we're starting a Q4 supplier whitelist & subscription sweep. Please confirm recurring vendors your team uses and flag any new one-off vendors by end of next week. Link to the intake sheet: https://docs.redwood.internal/vendor-sweep-2026 :spiral_calendar_pad:
Alex (finance): Thanks Lina — what's the deadline date you want? Also, any temporary PO threshold changes during the sweep? :thinking_face:
Lina (procurement): Deadline: Friday 2026-01-16 COB. No global PO threshold change, but for the sweep we need extra review for recurring charges > $500/month. If you have committed contracts, mark them as "contracted" in the sheet so we don't reopen them. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (eng): For cloud infra spend, do we list both SaaS (e.g., monitoring) and infra provider charges? Or only third-party vendors?
Lina (procurement): All recurring external vendors. Include SaaS subscriptions, managed services, and any infra add-ons billed by third parties. Internal chargebacks to Redwood teams (cost-center transfers) can be excluded.
Sam (product): One quick ask — we have a vendor pilot that totals ~$350/mo but with a 12-mo commitment. Do we still flag?
Maria (finance ops): Yes — flag it and put the contract length in the "notes" column. Anything with a commitment term needs the contract review checkbox ticked.
Emma (legal): Heads-up — if any new vendor handles PII, mark the security & legal review column and we'll prioritize. Typical turnaround is 3-5 business days once intake is complete.
Jordan (eng): Got it. Also, can we get a recommended tagging schema for billing so we can update our automation?
Lina (procurement): Recommended minimal tags — cost_center, team, project, vendor. Use this example when you add notes or paste export rows:

```
# tagging example
cost_center: platform
team: eng
project: inference-v2
vendor: Replicate
amount: $1200/mo
```

Maria (finance ops): Added a template for the Procurement Intake form on the sheet. Use the dropdowns where available to keep things consistent: https://docs.redwood.internal/vendor-sweep-2026#template :link:
Alex (finance): A couple of reminders: 1) If you need a one-off emergency vendor exception after the sweep window, use the ticket form in #help-procurement and tag @Lina. 2) Any recurring vendor not whitelisted after the sweep will require a manual PO and may be delayed in payment processing.
billing-bot: Automated reminder — monthly subscription export imported at 12:00 UTC. 42 new line items detected. :gear:
Lina (procurement): Small note on approvals — for SaaS subscriptions under $500/mo, the procurement team will auto-approve if the contract term is <= 12 months and no CPoR (critical provider of record) issues. Anything over $500/mo or multi-year commitments needs manual review. :memo:
Sam (product): Thanks — we'll run a quick audit and drop our list in the sheet today. :thumbsup:
Jordan (eng): Dropping a CSV export from our billing dashboard into the sheet now. Will tag rows with project codes.
Emma (legal): If any vendor requests expedited review, mark "expedite" and ping me directly. We'll triage.
Lina (procurement): Appreciate the quick responses. Final ask: teams, please keep entries concise (vendor, monthly cost, contract term, contact email, reason for use). If you already have a purchase request in a ticket, paste the ticket ID in the notes. I'll compile a whitelist and share by Monday 2026-01-19. :eyes:
